result.quote: “If you were to give me half your possessions, I still would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water in this place.
result.reason: The key paraphrases one supported part of verse 8, but the question is too broad: the man of God also says that he would not eat or drink there and explains the LORD’s command, so those are materially different defensible answers. In addition, the window does not identify the person addressed as a king. The question should specify which part of his reply is being requested.
